_comment: Real terrain of Jezero Crater, Mars. Generated by web/scripts/build-terrain.mjs. One file for both editions.

source.elevation: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM mosaic, 20 m/pixel (USGS Astrogeology for NASA Mars 2020; MRO Context Camera: NASA/JPL/MSSS)
source.image: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX orthomosaic, 6 m/pixel (same)
source.caption: This is the real terrain of Jezero Crater, from Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (CTX camera) data.

projection: Equirectangular, sphere radius 3396190 m, standard parallel 0 (map x is stretched east-west; multiply by cosLat for true metres)

elevationMetres.note: height.png value 0..65535 maps linearly to min..max (metres relative to the Mars areoid). Vertical scale in the game is 1:1.

outpost.name: near the Perseverance landing site (Octavia E. Butler Landing)
outpost.note: u,v = fraction across the square from the west and from the north edge

simplifications: The image is greyscale; the game tints it with Mars colours.
Detail smaller than 20 m (rocks, ripples) is procedural, not data.
